Mental Development and Research Centre: (Incorporation) Act, No. 2 of 2007
to provide necessary facilities for training in ethics
and exercising and developing of mental discipline
and    mental  development  etc.  in  Sri  Lanka  and
abroad ;
to provide necessary doctrinaire advice for resolving
mental crises, problems and any other similar issues
faced by the general public, ;
to  encourage    persons  in  various  educational
institutions  such  as  the  universities,  colleges  of
education,  pirivenas  and  schools  in  Sri  Lanka  as
well  as  abroad,    interested  in  mental  training,
developmental and research activities ; in promoting
these activities and providing necessary requisites
and library facilities for such research activities ;
to  assist  in  the  complete  physical  and  mental
development  of  the  young,  youthful  and  aged
persons  and  to  implement  necessary  programmes
for blind, mute and deaf children who require special
educational  facilities.
to educate people who are addicted to liquor, drugs,
and various vices and anti-social activities, with a
view to salvaging them from these addictions and
developing their knowledge and skills and advising
them on health habits ;
to take care of the aged parents under the protection
of  their  children  who  are  in  employment  and  to
engage them in mental training activities ; and
to  organize    vocational  training  activities  suitable
for school leavers.
